BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn is a psychiatric facility for school children located in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src2]. It operates as a specialized department under [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src3]. The clinic is notable for its high performance in national quality metrics for ADHD diagnostics. Specifically, it is one of only four departments nationwide that achieved the development target of ≥90% for Indicator 1 (somatic examination), reaching a compliance rate of 96% [^src1]. This makes it one of the best-performing units across the country in this regard [^src1].

The facility has also demonstrated significant improvement in other quality indicators. For Indicator 2b (environmental observation/interview), the clinic recorded the highest fulfillment rate nationally, moving from 34% in 2023/24 to 66% in 2024/25 [^src2]. This positive development in Region Midtjylland is highlighted in the annual quality report as a strategic success amid broader national challenges with low coverage, regional inequalities, and structural barriers [^src2]. 

In terms of operational volume and data registration, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn registered 61 ruled-out diagnostic pathways (afkræftede udredningsforløb) during the period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025 [^src3]. The clinic's medical staff includes [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]], who serves as a senior physician (overlæge) in Team 2 for school children's psychiatry at the Child and Adolescent Psychiatric Department (BUA) [^src3]. The clinic's data and performance are tracked using specific pathway markers to ensure accurate validation and the exclusion of non-relevant diagnostics from the national statistics [^src3].
